diagnostics.count_definition: K[group,t] = sum of original binary status variables over devices
diagnostics.storage_headroom_proof: For every power interval t=0..T-1, the transition from SOC[t] to SOC[t+1] and SOC bounds imply charging/discharging headroom bounds in each binary mode; the other mode has zero corresponding power. SOC[0] is the initial state.
